text.body:
{sāmbapañcāśikā
rājānakaśrīkṣemarājakṛtayā ṭīkayā sametā}
puṣṇan devānamṛtavisarairindumāsrāvya samyag bhābhiḥ svābhī rasayati rasaṃ yaḥ paraṃ nityameva | kṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇaṃ punarapi ca taṃ pūrayatyevamīdṛg dolālīlollasitahṛdayaṃ naumi cidbhānumekam || etadāveśavaivaśyapronmiṣaddhiṣaṇā vayam | vimṛśāmo manākchrīmatsāmbapañcāśikāstutim || so'yaṃ parāmṛtaraso rasajñairiha rasyatām | āyuṣyājyāmṛtasparśaḥ śatapadyā hi śāntaye ||
samastāgamamahāmnāyarahasyavinmahāyogīgisahasrasaṃpradāya(-) saṃpūrṇaḥ śrīvāsudevasya bhagavataḥ putraḥ śrīsāmbaḥ svātmavivasvatstutiṃ jagato'nugrahāya vaktumupakramate (-)
śabdārthatvavivartamānaparamajyotīruco gopate(-) rudgītho'bhyuditaḥ puro'ruṇatayā yasya trayīmaṇḍalam | bhāvyadvarṇapadakrameritatamaḥsaptasvarāśvairviya(-) dvidyāsyandanamunnayanniva namastasmai parabrahmaṇe || 1 ||
tasmai parasmai sarvotkṛṣṭāya viśvapūrṇādikartre ca | ata eva cābhāvaśāntabrahmacitrabrahmādisarvabrahmakroḍīkartre brahmaṇe bṛhate vyāpakāya bṛhaṇāya ca viśvakartre cidātmane namaḥ | dehādipramātṛtāpraśamanena tadevāviśāmītyarthaḥ | yasya brahmaṇaḥ sambandhi ūrdhvamaśeṣaviśvābhedātmatayā utkṛṣṭatayā gīyate vimṛśyata ityudrīthaḥ prathamonmeṣātmaśabdabrahmarūpaḥ praṇavo dhvaniḥ | devatāstutikarmapradhānasāmargyajurvedākhyā trayyeva śākhā prapañcakroḍīkṛtasamastāmnāyavākyaikavākyatāvyāptyā maṇḍalam | ataścaitatsarvāsāṃ vidyānāṃ mantraśāstravijñānānāṃ syandanamāspadaṃ prasavakāraṇaṃ ca karmabhūtaṃ ca viyatparākāśamunnayannullāsayaṃstanmayatvamāpādayanniva puraḥ prathamamaruṇatayā'tidīptatvenoditaḥ svayamunmiṣitaḥ | viyanmayasyāpyasya dīptasyonmeṣāvaṣṭambhapuraḥsaraṃ tathā sphuraṇādunnayannivetyuktam | etacca trayīmaṇḍalaṃ bhāsvadbhiḥ prodgīthāruṇimnā sphuritairvarṇapadakramairakṣaravācakatadānupūrvībhirīritaṃ dhvastaṃ tamo'jñānaṃ yena tādṛk | uccāraṇapadārthavākyārthapratipattiṣu paramacidabhedaviśrāntidamityarthaḥ | kena viyadunnayan | sapta ye svarāḥ svayaṃ rājamānā viśvākṣepiṇo varṇāḥ paśyantyādipravartanaprāṇitakalpāḥ ṣaḍjādidhvanivimarśāsta eva sarvatrāśusaṃcāritvādaśvāstaiḥ | yasya brahmaṇaḥ kīdṛśasya | gopateḥ parādivākprabhormarīcicakreśvarasya ca | ata eva śabdārthatvena nānālaukiketaraśabdatadarthatatsaṃbandhairvicitratayā vartamānaṃ svātantryādetadvaicitryābhāsātma yatparaṃ jyotiḥ śāktaṃ vīryaṃ tena ca rugdīptiryasya | bāhyasyāpi sūryasya jñānaśaktiḥ parā hyeṣā tapatyādityavigrahā ityāmnāyanītyā parabrahmapratibimbakalpasya praṇavavyāptiko'ruṇaḥ pūrvamuditaḥ | trayīvyāptikaṃ maṇḍalamitaravidyāvyāptikaṃ syandanaṃ ca karmabhāsvadvarṇaiḥ padakramairdedīpyamānacaraṇavinyāsairīritatamaso ye saptasvaravyāptikā aśvāstairviyadutkṣipati | atha ca vicitravācyavācakātmajagadvṛtteściccakreśvarasyodgīthaḥ śaktyaṅkuronmeṣo dīpto brahmaviṣṇurudrajāgratsvapnasuṣuptibrahmamūlamāyāṇḍāditrayī(-) maṇḍalam | viyadvyāpakam | vedanānādidharmasya paramātmatvabodhanā ityādyāmnāyaniruktonmanāśaktyākhyā vidyāsyandanaṃ svarairvicitrairmantrairdhvanibhirunnayanniva prathamamuditaḥ | kiṃ kṛtvā (?) bhāsvatāṃ varṇānāmākārādimātrāṇāṃ padānāṃ bindvādiviśrāntīnāṃ krameṇa paripāṭyā īritaṃ tamaḥ samanāntaṃ pāśajālaṃ yatra || 1 ||
evaṃ sāmānyavyāptyā paramārkaṃ stutvā dehasthamadhyanāḍīvyāptyā stauti (-)
omityantanadati niyataṃ yaḥ pratiprāṇi śabdo vāṇī yasmāt prasarati parā śabdatanmātragarbhā | prāṇāpānau vahati ca samau yo mitho grāsasaktau dehasthaṃ taṃ sapadi paramādityamādyaṃ prapadye || 2 ||
taṃ paramādityaṃ parabrahmasvarūpameva dehasthitaṃ madhyanāḍīgataprāṇabrahmaniviṣṭam ādyaṃ viśvacitrabhittibhūtaṃ sapadi prapadye abhisandhyavadhānena samāviśāmi | kaṃ tamityāha (-) ya omitiśabdaḥ kroḍīkṛtāśeṣaśabdanātmanādarūpo mahāpraṇavaḥ pratiprāṇi sarvabhūteṣu niyatamavicchinnapravāheṇāntarnadati parāvāgātmasvarūpaṃ vimṛśan sthitaḥ | yasmācca śabdatanmātragarbhā āsūtritakramā ādikṣāntaśabdasāmānyamātrā'vibhāgajyotirmayī parādvitīyā vāṇī paśyantī prasaratyunmiṣati | yaśca mitho grāsasaktāvanyonyakavalanaparau samau samānabhūmikārūḍhau prāṇāpānau vahati | udānavahnyātmanijamahājyotirmayau karoti || 2 ||
evaṃ mahāvyāptyā sūkṣmavyāptyā cānavacchinnaṃ madhyadhāmasthaṃ ca cidarkaṃ nutvā prapañcavyāptyāpi stauti (-)
yastvakcakṣuḥśravaṇarasanāghrāṇapāṇyaṅghrivāṇī(-) pāyupasthasthitirapi manobuddhyahaṅkāramūrtiḥ | tiṣṭhatyantarbahirapi jagadbhāsayan dvādaśātmā mārtaṇḍaṃ taṃ sakalakaraṇādhāramekaṃ prapadye || 3 ||
mṛtānāṃ vedyaikarūpatayā śavaprāyāṇāmaṇḍānāṃ dehaprāṇādipiṇḍānāmayamanuprāṇako mārtaṇḍaścidbhānustamekamadvitīyamapi prapañcavyāptyā sakalānāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ sakalāni karaṇāni ca trayodaśakaraṇāni ca teṣāmādhāramanuprāṇakamavibhinnamāśrayaṃ prapadye | yastvagādyahaṅkārāntasvīkṛtatrayodaśendriyamūrtiḥ | ataścāntarahaṅkārātmā vedagrāhakarūpaḥ bahiścādhyavasāyādi vyāpārabuddhyādikaraṇadvādaśātmā grāhyarūpaṃ jagadbhāsayaṃstiṣṭhatīti sthūladṛśārthaḥ | rahasyadṛśā tu gṛhītasarvendriyamūrtirapi yaḥ sṛṣṭyādimarīcicakracitrasaṃcāracāturyāddvādaśātmā eka eva cidarko'ntarbahiśca jagatkālānalādi vyomakalāntaṃ viśvaṃ bhāsayaṃsturyadhāmātmanijabhāsā cakramayatvamāpādayan sarvakaraṇānyādhāratayā nijaujojvalanajvalitānyāśritya sthitastaṃ prakarṣeṇa prapadye | nijavyutthānaṃ sākṣātkurvan sthito'smītyarthaḥ || 3 ||
prapañcavyāptyākhilendriyādhāre stute'pi bhagavati prakāśavimarśaparamārthe tadvimarśaprasarasaraṇiṃ vāṇīṃ stauti (-)
yā sā mitrāvaruṇasadanāduccarantī triṣaṣṭiṃ varṇānatra prakaṭakaraṇaiḥ prāṇasaṅgāt prasūtān | tāṃ paśyantīṃ prathamamuditāṃ madhyamāṃ buddhisaṃsthāṃ vācaṃ vaktre karaṇaviśadāṃ vaikharīṃ ca prapadye || 4 ||
avibhāgāttu paśyantī sarvataḥ saṃhṛtakramā | svarūpajyotirevāntaḥ sūkṣmā vāganapāyinī || ityādinā lakṣitāṃ prathamamādābuditāmunmiṣitāṃ tāṃ svarūpajyotīrūpāṃ paśyantyākhyāṃ tadanu tāmeva buddhisaṃsthāṃ buddhyabhyāsaṃ prāptām | kevalaṃ buddhyupādānāt kramarūpānupātinī prāṇavṛttimatikramya madhyamā vāk pravartate || ityādilakṣitām | madhye bhavatvānmadhyamāṃ madhye'ntaḥkaraṇe vartamānām | tadanu vaktre vadane karaṇeṣu jihvāmūlajihvāmadhyamādiṣu viśadāṃ nirmalām | sthāneṣu vivṛte vāyau kṛtavarṇaparigrahā | vaikharī vākprayoktṝṇāṃ prāṇavṛttinibandhanā || ityādinā lakṣitām | vikhare śarīre bhavatvāttadākhyāṃ vācaṃ prapanno'smi | kāṃ tāmityāha (-) yā sā mitrāvaruṇasadanādagnīṣomamayātmanaḥ parāvākpradhānānmadhyadhāmno'karādīṃstriṣaṣṭiṃ varṇānuccarantī āsūtritakramatayā bhedābhedābhyāṃ bhedena ca vimṛśantī | kenoccarantī (?) prakaṭairantarmukhībhāvenābhinnasphuṭaprakāśaikamadhyamāptaiḥ karaṇaiḥ sarvendriyaiḥ | kīdṛśān varṇān (?) prāṇasaṅgāt prasūtānudbhūtān | tatra cijjyotiṣi guṇībhūtasūkṣmaprāṇasaṅgāt paśyantyāṃ guṇībhūtacitsūkṣmaprāṇasaṅgānmadhyamāyāṃ sthūlaprāṇasaṅgādvaikharyāṃ varṇā jāyante | te ca triṣaṣṭiḥ | tadyathā (-) a(-) i(-) u (-)ṛ (-) varṇāścatvāro hrasvadīrghaplutabhedā dvādaśa ḷkārasya dīrgho nāstīti hrasvaplutabhedād dvividhaḥ | saṃdhyakṣarāṇāṃ hrasvā na santīti dīrghaplutabhedādaṣṭavidhāḥ | evaṃ svarā dvāviṃśatiḥ | kādayo māntāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ sparśāḥ | antasthāścatvāraḥ | ūṣmāṇaścatvāraḥ | kuṃ khuṃ guṃ dhuṃ iti yamāścatvāraḥ | anusvāravisargajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyā aṃ aḥ (/) ka (/) pa iti catvāraḥ | yathoktam (-)
svarā dvāviṃśatiścaiva sparśānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | yādayaḥ śādayaścāṣṭau catvāraśca yamāḥ smṛtāḥ || anusvāro visargaśca (/) ka (/) pa iti parāśrayau | ta ete gaditā varṇāstriṣaṣṭiriha sūribhiḥ || iti |
mitraḥ sūryo'ntaraśeṣadvaitaploṣakāritvādagniḥ | varuṇo hlādāpyāyakāritvāt somaḥ | varṇānantaḥ prakaṭakaraṇaiḥ prāṇasaṅgāt prasūte iti pāṭhāntare yā parāvākśaktirmitrāvaruṇasadanāduccarantī pramāṇaprameyātmakasūryacandrāśrayeṇātmākāśādūrdhvaṃ sarantī sarvottīrṇaṃ nijaṃ dhāma pramātṛrūpaṃ sravantī asti | saivāntaḥ prakaṭairantareva sphuṭairindriyaiḥ kṛtvā triṣaṣṭiṃ varṇān prāṇasaṅgāddhetoḥ prasūte janayatītyanvayaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ rūpādyupalabdhyānumeyatvād bahiḥ sphuṭatvābhāvenāntaḥ prakaṭībhāvaḥ | etadabhidheyapakṣe uccāraṇaprasūtyoḥ krameṇānuvādyavidheyabhāvaḥ || 4 ||
evaṃ vākprasarāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ stutvā madhyamadhāmasāphalyamarthayate (-)
ūrdhvādhaḥsthānyatanubhuvanānyantarā saṃniviṣṭā nānānāḍiprasavagahanā sarvabhūtāntarasthā | prāṇāpānagrasananirataiḥ prāpyate brahmanāḍī sā naḥ śvetā bhavatu paramādityamūrtiḥ prasannā || 5 ||
paramādityasya cidbhānorbrahmanāḍīrūpā yā seti divyā mūrtiḥ samucchritākṛtirno'smākaṃ prasannā praśastā praśamitaprāṇādikāluṣyā ata eva śvetā cidānandaghanatayā sphurantī astu | kīdṛśī sā (?) yā ūrdhvamadhaśca sthitāni atanūnyanalpāni anāśritādikālāgnyantabhuvaneśanānābhuvanāni dehe bahiścāntarā madhye saṃniviṣṭā vyāpyāvasthitā | tathā nānānāḍīnāṃ cakṣurādiromarandhrāntānāṃ suṣirāṇāṃ prasavena sphāreṇa gahanā sarvairduṣprāpā | sarveṣāṃ sthāvarādidevayonibhedāntānāṃ bhūtānāmantarasthā dehamadhye vartamānā | yataścoktayuktyā gahanā ata eva kaiścideva prāṇāpānayoḥ sarvavāhaprasavapraveśayorgrasananiratairbhakṣaṇapragalbhaiḥ prāpyate samāviśyate || 5 ||
kiñca (-)
na brahmāṇḍavyavahitapathā nātiśītoṣṇarūpā no vā naktaṃdivagamamitātāpanīyāparāhuḥ | vaikuṇṭhīyā tanuriva rave rājate maṇḍalasthā sā naḥ śvetā bhavatu paramādityamūrtiḥ prasannā || 6 ||
brahmaṇo brahmabilāvaraṇaniviṣṭasyāṇḍaṃ garbhīkṛtabhūmūlamāyāṇḍaprapañcaśaktyaṇḍaṃ tena na vyavahitā api tu samantataḥ kroḍīkārī panthāḥ prasaramārgo yasyāḥ(,) tathā atiśītaḥ somaḥ(,) atyuṣṇo vahniḥ(,) iyaṃ tu dvaitadāhādadvaitānandasyanditvācca naivaṃrūpā | api tu samarasībhūtāgnīṣomātmā | tathā naktaṃdinaṃ rātridinaṃ yo gamo bhramaṇaṃ tena no itā prameyabhāvaṃ na prāptā tadvatī | tathā atāpanīyā paramāhlādapradā | tathā apagato rāhurācchādanapradhānaḥ śūnyapramātā yasyāḥ sā | kiñca(,) raveścidbhānormaṇḍale raśmipariveṣe rājate dīpyate | bāhyārkamūrtistu brahmāṇḍavyavahitā svarlokāntamātrāvabhāsikā śiśiragrīṣmādāvatiśītoṣṇarūpā aharniśaṃ bhramantī santāpikā rāhvabhibhūtā ceti vyatirekadhvaniḥ | vaikuṇṭhasya viṣṇormūrtirivetyupamā | sāpi ca balivañcanāvasare brahmāṇḍe brahmāṇḍāntarniruddhamārgā na kenacit | ata eva nātiśītoṣṇarūpā | prakāśāhlādadā bhaktānāmityarthaḥ | naktaṃdivagamenāhorātraparibhramaṇena na mitā | devādibhirneyattayā paricchinnetyarthaḥ | tāpanīyā mahāpratāpavatī | apagatarāhurapakrāntaravimaṇḍalā ceti śleṣaḥ | evamayamatropamāśleṣo vyatirekadhvaninā saṃsṛṣṭaḥ || 6 ||
atha yugapadantarbahiścārkamūrtiṃ stauti (-)
yatrārūḍhaṃ triguṇavapuṣi brahma tadbindurūpaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ yadapi paramaṃ bhāti nirvāṇamārgaḥ | trayyādhāraḥ praṇava iti yanmaṇḍalaṃ caṇḍaraśme(-) rantaḥsūkṣmaṃ bahirapi bṛhanmuktaye'haṃ prapannaḥ || 7 ||
taccaṇḍaraśmeściddīptāṃśormaṇḍalaṃ muktaye samāveśātmajīvanmuktyarthaṃ prapanno'smi | kīdṛśam (?) antaścidbhuvi sūkṣmamādyonmeṣātma | yogīndraireva labhyam | bahirapi bṛhanmahāparimāṇam | yatra sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārakārirajaḥsattvatamoniviṣṭabrahmaviṣṇurudrābhidhāyyakāro(-) kāramakārākhyahrasvadīrghaplutavarṇatrayātmatriguṇavapuṣi praṇave viśvavedyāvibhāgavedanātmā binduriti tadupalakṣitonmanāntāprameyaparipāṭīrūpaṃ yasya tādṛg brahma bṛhad bṛṃhakaṃ ca śāktateja ārūḍhamatyutkṛṣṭatayā vyavasthitam | yacca paramamasāmānyam | yogīndrāṇāṃ mitayogyatiśāyiparatattvaikabhājāṃ nirvāṇamārgo jīvanmuktyupāyo bhāti svaprakāśatayā sphurati | trayyāḥ prāṅnirṇītāyā ādhāra āśrayaḥ | prakarṣeṇa nūyate utkṛṣṭatayā vimṛśyate paraṃ pārameśvaraṃ svarūpaṃ yeneti kṛtvā praṇava ityetannāma yat | bāhye'pyarkamaṇḍale navayojanasāhasro vigraho'rkasya maṇḍalam | triguṇam iti svacchandādiṣṭanītyā yatra bindurūpamiti sitavartulākāraṃ brahmamayaṃ tadasāmānyaṃ bimbamārūḍham | tacca yogināṃ nirvāṇamārgaḥ(,) teṣāṃ hi sūryamaṇḍalabhedanasya śravaṇāt | tathā vakṣyamāṇadṛśā sāmargyajurmayadhāmamaṇḍalākṛtitvāt trayyādhāraḥ | prakarṣeṇa nūyamānatvātpraṇavo viśva śarītvācca praṇavaḥ || 7 ||
yasmin somaḥ surapitṛnarairanvahaṃ pīyamānaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣīṇaḥ praviśati yato vardhate cāpi bhūyaḥ | yasmin vedā madhuni saraghākāravadbhānti cāgre taccaṇḍāṃśoramitamamṛtaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ prapadye || 8 ||
cidbhānormaṇḍalasthaṃ madhyadhāmaniviṣṭaṃ tatparamānandarūpamamitamanalpamamṛtaṃ prapadye samāśraye | yatrāmṛte somaḥ sarvo meyavargaḥ surādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ pramātṛbhiḥ pratidinaṃ kalāgrāsayuktyā pīyamānatvāt kṣīṇaḥ kṣīṇaḥ san punaḥ punaḥ praviśati hṛdviśrāntyanantaraṃ nimajjati | yata eva maṇḍalād bhūyo'pi vardhate'bhivyajyate meyarūpaścandraḥ | yasmiṃśca vedāḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi madhuni mākṣike saraghāṇāṃ madhukarīṇāmākāra ivāgre bhānti puraḥ sphuranti | yathā saraghā mākṣikaṃ saṃcitya parivṛttya sollāsamāsate(,) tathā sarve vedā vākyaikavākyatayā parādvayamamṛtamāmṛśya bhrājante | bāhyo'pi somaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu pitṛdevanaragrastakalāpañcadaśako'māvāsyāyāṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ praviśya vardhate | vedāścārkajyotirlagnā āsate || 8 ||
aindrīmāśāṃ pṛthukavapuṣā pūrayitvā krameṇa krāntāḥ sapta prakaṭahariṇā yena pādena lokāḥ | kṛtvā dhvāntaṃ vigalitabalivyaktipātālalīnaṃ viśvālokaḥ sa jayati raviḥ sattvamevordhvaraśmiḥ || 9 ||
yo hi yasmād guṇotkṛṣṭaḥ sa tasmādūrdhvamiṣyate iti sthityā ūrdhvā viśvotkṛṣṭā raśmayo yasya | ata eva satāṃ vidyamānānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ bhāvaḥ sattvaṃ mahāprakāśātmarūpam | tadeva tatparamārthaḥ | tataśca prakāśamānatayā prakāśātmanyeva viśvasya magnatvāt prakāśo viśvālokaḥ sa eva raviścidbhānurjayati sarvotkarṣeṇa vartate | yenaindrīmāśāṃ prācyonmeṣadaśāṃ pṛthukavapuṣā yogigamyasūkṣmaśāktaspandātmanā pūrayitvā unmiṣitaprāṇādisaṃkocacitprādhānyocchalitāṃ kṛtvā śivādisakalātmāntāḥ śaktimantaḥ prakīrtitāḥ iti śrīpūrvādiṣṭanītyā śivamantramaheśvaramantreśvaramantravijñānākalapralayākalasakalākhyāḥ kramātkramaṃ prāṇīyatuṭisthā nijaśaktisahitāḥ saptalokāḥ pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni iti sthityā pādena nijāṃśamātreṇākrāntāḥ kroḍīkṛtya svajyotirmayīkṛtāḥ | kīdṛśena (?) prakaṭāḥ svātmābhāsā rūpādiviśvaharaṇāddharayaścakṣurādiśaktayo yasya | taduktaṃ śrutau (-) yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā daśa iti | niḥsaṃkhyaśaktirātmeti hyasyārthaḥ | kathaṃ krāntāḥ (?) dhvāntamātmanyanātmapratītyātmājñānaṃ vigalitā baliranātmanyātmābhidhāyinī vyaktiryasya tādṛk pātālalīnaṃ niḥśeṣapraśamitaṃ kṛtvā | bāhyenāpyarkeṇa saptāśvārūḍhenaindrīṃ diśaṃ sūkṣmarūpeṇāpūrya bhūrādilokāḥ pādena marīcibhirdhvāntaṃ dhvaṃsayitvā krameṇa krāntāḥ | prakaṭahariṇā ca nārāyaṇena vigalitā balyākhyasya dānavendrasya vyaktiryatra taddhvāntaṃ dānavakulaṃ pātālalīnaṃ kṛtvā bhūrādilokāścaraṇavinyāsakrameṇākrāntāḥ | kiṃ kṛtvā (?) pṛthukavapuṣā bālavāmanaśarīreṇa indrādidigāpūraṇaṃ kṛtvā | so'pi viśvālokaḥ sattvapradhānaścetyatra śleṣālaṅkāraḥ | śleṣopamādhvanisaṃsṛṣṭiriyam || 9 ||
dhyātvā brahma prathamamatanu prāṇamūle nadantaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāntaḥ praṇavamukharaṃ vyāhṛtīḥ samyaguktvā | yattadvede taditi saviturbrahmaṇoktaṃ vareṇyaṃ tadbhargākhyaṃ kimapi paramaṃ dhāmagarbhaṃ prapadye || 10 ||
brahmaṇā prajāpatinā vedeṣu praṇavamukharamoṅkāroccāraṇapūrva tadityādi gāyatryāḥ saviturviśvaprasūtihetościdādityasya yattatkimapītyasāmānyaṃ bharga ityākhyā yasya tatparamaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ dhāma parisphurattātma śāktaṃ tejo bāhyasūryasomavahnyādidhāmakroḍīkāritvāddhāmagarbhaṃ vareṇyamanugrahakāri ukta tatprapadye samāviśāmi | kiṃ kṛtvā brahmaṇoktam (?) kiṃ kṛtvā ca prapadye (?) prathamamādāvatanu aśarīraṃ śrībhargaśikhādiṣṭanītyā akāraparāmarśātma vīreśvarākhyaṃ ca brahma bṛhad bṛṃhakaṃ ca paraṃ śāktaṃ dhāma prāṇamūle aprāṇādyasphurattādhāmni dhyātvā vicintyānantaraṃ nadantamiti nādākhyaṃ paravimarśātmānamantarityuktaśāktarūpaprāṇitakalpatayā sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā svātmatayā sākṣātkṛtya tannādavimarśānupraveśāvaṣṭambhabalonmiṣatpraṇavoccāraṇapūrvam | tathā bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhā bhurbhūvaḥ svaḥ svāhā iti ca mantrarūpā samagrameyamānapramātṝṇāṃ sasaṃskārāṇāṃ parabrahmamayatvāmarśinīrvyāhṛtīścatasraḥ samyagityantarāmarśāvaṣṭambhāśaithilyenoktvā uccārya | atha ca sarvavyavahārānekarūpāḥ kathā japaḥ iti śivasūtrādiṣṭanītyā tadabhedāmarśapradhānatayā paraśāktarasaplāvitān saṃpādya | śāktadhāmaikāgryavaśāsāditaśāmbhavadhāmāvaṣṭambhabalena vyutthānadaśāmapi tadabhedarasaprokṣitāṃ vidhāyetyarthaḥ | dhāmagarbhamityatra dhāmaśabdastantreṇa dviruktaḥ | tathā praṇavamukharamiti || 10 ||
tvāṃ stoṣyāmi stutibhiriti me yastu bhedagraho'yaṃ saivāvidyā tadapi sutarāṃ tadvināśāya yuktaḥ | staumyevāhaṃ trividhamuditaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaṃ paraṃ vā vidyopāyaḥ para iti budhairgīyate khalvavidyā || 11 ||
he bhagavan(,) tvāṃ stutibhiḥ stoṣyāmīti stotṛstutyastutikalpanātmā yo me bhedagraha eṣaiva cidadvayāprathanātmāvidyā(,) tathāpi tasyā avidyāyāḥ sutarāmatiśayena vināśāya niḥśeṣonmūlanāya yukto nityasaṃbaddhastvāṃ staumyeva dehādipramātṛtānimajjanena sarvotkṛṣṭatayā satataṃ parāmṛśāmi(,) na tu kṣaṇamapyudāsīna āse | tvāmeva cidarkaṃ staumi na tu parimitāṃ kāñcana devatām | kīdṛśaṃ tvām (?) sthūlaṃ bāhyaprāṇārkarūpam | sūkṣmaṃ madhyanāḍīgataṃ prāṇabrahmarūpam | paraṃ cānavacchinnaṃ viśvātmacidānandaghanam | taditi prāktanavākyavyāvarṇitamekameva | nityoditaṃ ca | vāśabdaścārthe | yuktaṃ caitat | yato budhaistattvajñairavidyaiva vidyopāyaḥ para ityuktaḥ | stotrastutyādivibhāgakalpanātmāvidyayā samastāvidyābījadehādipramātṛtvābhimānapraśamanena cidānandaghanaparamātmotkarṣaparāmarśātmā stutiḥ paramasamāveśapradetyarthaḥ || 11 ||
staumyevetyuktiṃ prapañcayati (-)
yo'nādyanto'pyatanuraguṇo'ṇoraṇīyān mahīyān viśvākāraḥ saguṇa iti vā kalpanākalpitāṅgaḥ | nānābhūtaprakṛtivikṛtīrdarśayan bhāti yo vā tasmai tasmai bhavatu paramāditya nityaṃ namaste || 12 ||
he paramāditya cidarka(,) tasmai tasmai iti parasūkṣmasthūlarūpāya viśvātmane tubhyaṃ nityaṃ namaḥ | sarvakālaṃ dehādiprahvatayā parāmṛśaṃstvāmeva samāviśāmītyarthaḥ | kīdṛśāya tasmai (?) yo anādyanto deśakālādyanavacchinnaḥ | atanurākārāniyantritaḥ | ataśca sārvajñādiguṇāspṛṣṭaḥ | aṇoratyantasūkṣmarūpatayā yogidṛśyāt paramāṇorapyaṇīyānatisūkṣmaḥ na kasyāpi vedyaḥ | api tu svaprakāśacidekarūpaḥ na tu deśataḥ saṃkucitaḥ | paramāṇoḥ sūkṣmasya vedyatvād dṛśyatvācca | mahīyān vyāpakaḥ | ataśca viśvakroḍīkāritvādviśvākāraḥ | sārvajñādiguṇayogāt saguṇaḥ | ityevaṃ prakārayā kalpanayā kalpitāni pṛthakpṛthagullikhitānyaṅgāni tattaddharmarūpā avayavabhāgā yasya tādṛg vetyanayoktyā'vacchinnavastuviṣayaśabdavikalpāsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ paramekaṃ svarūpamanavacchinnamiti dhvanayati | nānābhūtāni vicitrāḥ sthāvarādibrahmāṇḍāntāḥ prāṇinasteṣāṃ prakṛtīrmāyāprakṛtiśukraśoṇitādikāraṇāni(,) vikṛtīḥ kalābuddhidehādikān darśayan ya ābhāti | saṃkucitasarvābhāsollāsakatayā vā yaḥ sphuratītyarthaḥ || 12 ||
tattvākhyāne tvayi munijanā neti neti bruvantaḥ śrāntāḥ samyak tvamiti na ca tairīdṛśo veti coktaḥ | tasmāttubhyaṃ nama iti vacomātramevāsmi vacmi prāyo yasmātprasaratitarāṃ bhāratī jñānagarbhā || 13 ||
yasmāttvatto bhāratī paśyantyādivāk jñānagarbhā svāvabhāsasaṃvitpradhānā prasarati tasmai tubhyaṃ nama iti vacomātrameva(,) na tvatiriktaṃ stutivākyādi vacmi | jñānasya sarvavākprasarahetoranavacchinnasya vibhinnastutivāgbhiḥ stotumaśakyatvāt | namaḥśabdena tu dehādiprahvatāṃ turīyakasvacitprakarṣaparāmarśanasya kartuṃ śakyatvāt | yuktaṃ caitat | yasmānmunayo'pi tvayi tvadviṣaye tattvākhyāne aṇurna mahān na hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ netyādi bruvantaḥ śrāntāḥ kliṣṭāḥ | na ca taistvamityevaṃvidho'sīti etādṛśo veti etattulyo veti samyaguktaḥ | vāgagocaratvādevetyarthaḥ || 13 ||
sarvāṅgīṇaḥ sakalavapuṣāmantare yo'ntarātmā tiṣṭhan kāṣṭhe dahana iva no dṛśyase yuktiśūnyaiḥ | yaśca prāṇāraṇiṣu niyatairmathyamānāsu sadbhi(-) rdṛśyaṃ jyotirbhavasi paramāditya tasmai namaste || 14 ||
he paramāditya cidarka(,) tasmai nirviśeṣāya te tubhyaṃ namaḥ | yastvaṃ sthāvarādidevayonyantānāṃ rudrakṣetrajñānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvāṅgeṣu bhavo vyāpakaḥ sakalavapuṣāmantare mitagrāhakātmani svarūpe yo'ntarātmā paramānandatvāt ātmā caivāntarātmā ca iti śrīsvacchandādiṣṭapuryaṣṭakapramātā tiṣṭhannavasthāsnurapi yuktyā yogena śūnyairapi na dṛśyase | yathā kāṣṭhe'gnistiṣṭhannapi yuktiśūnyairaraṇimathanānabhijñairna dṛśyate tatkāṣṭhakavalīkārijvaladrūpatayā nopalabhyate | yaśca tvaṃ prāṇāraṇiṣu sarvavāhamārgodaya viśrāntipadeṣu sadbhiryogibhirniyatairabhiyuktairmathyamānāsu (-) ūrdhvaśaktinipātācca adhaḥśaktinikuñcanāt | rudraśaktisamāveśaṃ yo jānāti sa paṇḍitaḥ || ityāmnāyādiṣṭayuktyā'navaratāndolanataḥ praśamitamarudvyāpikāsu dṛśyaṃ jyotirbhavasi svaprakāśacidrūpaḥ sphurasi | atra paryāyeṇa prāṇāpānāvurdhvādharāraṇirūpau | yogiprayatno mathanakāṣṭham || 14 ||
stotā stutyaḥ stutiriti bhavān kartṛkarmakriyātmā krīḍatyekastava nutividhāvasvatantrastato'ham | yadvā vacmi praṇayasubhagaṃ gopate tacca tathyaṃ tvatto hyanyatkimiva jagatāṃ vidyate tanmṛṣā syāt || 15 ||
he gopate cinmarīcicakreśvara(,) bhavāneko'dvitīyaḥ stotrādirūpatayā krīḍati svasvātantryāttattadrūpatayā sphurati | yaduktaṃ mayaiva bhairavānukaraṇastotre (-) stotā stutyaḥ stutiriti yadapi vibhinnaṃ na kiñcidastīha | mṛśasi yathā yadrūpaṃ cidrūpatayā bhavasyetat || iti | yato'hamiti bhavatkalpitameva | tato'hamiti saṃkocapradhāno māyāpramātā tvatstotrakaraṇe'svatantrastvāmeva cidātmānaṃ staumi | na tvahaṃ nāmānyaḥ kaścidityarthaḥ | yacca kiñcittvadātmaivāhaṃ praṇayasubhagaṃ prārthanāsundaraṃ vacmi tatsarvaṃ tathyaṃ tvatparamārthameva | yatastvattaścidātmano vyatiriktaṃ jagatāṃ kimiva vidyate (?) na kiñcidasti | yadi vā tathāpi kiñcitsaṃkalpyate tanmṛṣā syāt | naiva bhavet | cidātmatāṃ vinā kasyacidapi cetanā ceti tasya saṃkalpavikalpaviṣayatvasyāpyayogena gaganakusumato'pi nikṛṣṭatvāt | itthaṃ yuktitastvadabhedasāraiva stutiḥ || 15 ||
prātītikakrameṇa tu yadyapi bhedastathāpītthaṃ tvamārādhyo'smākamityāha (-)
jñānaṃ nāntaḥkaraṇarahitaṃ vidyate'smādvidhānāṃ tvaṃ cātyantaṃ sakalakaraṇāgocaratvādacintyaḥ | dhyānātītastvamiti na vinā bhaktiyogena labhya(-) stasmādbhaktiṃ śaraṇamamṛtaprāptaye'haṃ prapannaḥ || 16 ||
aindriyakajñānavatāṃ māyāpramātṝṇāmasmākamindriyāgocaro bhavānacintyatvāddhyānaviṣayo na bhavatīti dehādimitapramātṛtāmajjanonmajjanacidarkabhajanātmakabhaktiyoga(-) saṃpādanīyatvādbhagavato bhaktimeva śāktasphārāveśamayāmṛtaprāptaye'smyāśritaḥ | uktaṃ ca vijñānabhairave (-) bhaktyudrekādviraktasya yādṛśī jāyate daśā | sā śaktiḥ śāṅkarī nityaṃ bhāvayettāṃ tataḥ śivaḥ || iti || 16 ||
hārdaṃ hanti prathamamuditā yā tamaḥsaṃśritānāṃ sattvodrekāttadanu ca rajaḥ karmayogakrameṇa | svabhyastā ca prathayatitarāṃ sattvameva prapannā nirvāṇāya vrajati śamināṃ te'rka bhaktitrayīva || 17 ||
he arka(,) tava bhaktiḥ prapannā samāśritā satī śamināṃ śāntarāgādikalaṅkānāṃ nirvāṇāya mokṣāya vrajati jīvacchivatvābhivyaktaye ghaṭate | trayī yathā | sāpi hi kāmyakarma parihṛtyānuṣṭhīyamānā trayyantavidāmapavargahetuḥ | tathā caiṣā prathamamuditā samunmiṣitamātrā hārdaṃ prakāśānandātmahṛdbhavaṃ tamastvabhedākhyātirūpamāṇavaṃ malaṃ saṃśritānāṃ bhaktibhājāṃ hanti nāśayati | tadanu sattvasya prakāśasyodrekātprakarṣātkarmayogakrameṇa svātmadevatāviśrāntiphalaśārīrakarmānuṣṭhānena kārmamalarūpaṃ rajo hanti | tathā suṣṭhu abhyastā pariśīlanena svīkṛtā sato bhāvaḥ sattvaṃ prakāśaikaghanatvameva prakāśamāne sarvatra prathayatitarām | na tu paśuvanmāyīyamalātmabhinnavedyaprathākṛt | trayyapi trayyantavidāṃ tanniṣṭhānāṃ sattvaṃ prathayati || 17 ||
tāmāsādya śriyamiva gṛhe kāmadhenuṃ pravāse dhvānte bhātiṃ dhṛtimiva vane yojane brahmanāḍim | nāvaṃ cāsmin viṣamaviṣayagrāhasaṃsārasindhau gaccheyaṃ te paramamamṛtaṃ yanna śītaṃ na coṣṇam || 18 ||
tāṃ bhaktimāśritya cidarkasya te sambandhi paramamamṛtaṃ paraṃ śāktaṃ dhāma gaccheyaṃ samāviśeyam | yacchaiśiragraiṣmabāhyārkadhāmavailakṣaṇyācchītamuṣṇaṃ ca na bhavati | api tu mohadāhaprakāśāhlādakṛdagniṣomātma | kīdṛśīṃ tām (?) gṛhe śūnye veśmani śriyamiva | sampūrṇabhogapradatvāt | pravāse riktabandhudeśe kāmadhenumiva cintitamātrābhīṣṭaphalapradatvāt | dhvānte gāḍhatamasi bhātimiva | pūrṇaprathāhetutvāt | vane gahanaparvatādau dhṛtimiva | viśrāntihetutvāt | yojane paraśivātmaikyāveśe brahmanāḍiṃ suṣumṇām | paramopāyatvāt | viṣamaviṣayā eva grāhā bhīṣaṇā jalacarā yatra tādṛśe saṃsārasamudre nāvamiva | uttārakatvāt || 18 ||
agnīṣomāvakhilajagataḥ kāraṇaṃ tau mayukhaiḥ sargādāne sṛjasi bhagavan hrāsavṛddhikrameṇa | tāvevāntarviṣuvati samau juhvatāmātmavahnau dvāvapyastaṃ nayasi yugapanmuktaye bhaktibhājām || 19 ||
he bhagavan(,) akhilasya bāhyasya nīlasukhādergrāhyarūpasyāntarasya ca grāhakarūpasya dehāderjagato yāvagnīṣomau sarvavāhavāhī prāṇo'pānaśca prakāśanāvasthānahetutvātkāraṇam | tau prasisṛkṣāpravivikṣātmasargādānasamaye vastvābhāsanavimarśātmasṛṣṭyādau tannimittaṃ ca hrāsavṛddhikrameṇa dvādaśaṣoḍaśakalākalanaparyāyato mayukhaiḥ sṛṣṭyādi devyātmanijamarīcibhiḥ sṛjasi muhurmuhurnirmimīṣe | tāveva ca bhaktibhājāmantarviṣuvati samyṅnayanātmasamānamarutpradhāne kumbhake samau somasūryakalānyonyasaṃgharṣamiśritau santāvātmavahnāvudānavahnau juhvatāṃ muktaye śivātmabhedaprathārūpāṇavādimalatrayapluṣṭopalakṣitaśivādvaitaprāptaye dvāvapi yugapatkramaṃ mayūkhairevāstaṃ nayasi viśvātmakavyānavyāptimāviśya jñānakriyātmaparāgnīṣomarūpasvātmamayau saṃpādayasi || 19 ||
sthūlatvaṃ te prakṛtigahanaṃ naiva lakṣyaṃ hyanantaṃ sūkṣmatvaṃ vā tadapi sadasadvyaktyabhāvādacintyam | dhyāyāmītthaṃ kathamaviditaṃ tvāmanādyantamanta(-) stasmādarka praṇiyini mayi svātmanaiva prasīda || 20 ||
he arka(,) te tava sthūlatvaṃ viśvavyāpakatvaṃ prakṛtyā gahanatvānnaiva lakṣayituṃ śakyam | yasmādanantaṃ dikkālākārairanavacchinnam | sūkṣmatvamapi vā aṇoraṇīyān ityetadvyākhyānāvasaravyākṛtayuktyā parapramātrātma yattadapi sadasadvyaktyabhāvādbhāvābhāvarūpatvenāpratīteracintyam | taditthamanādyantatvādaviditaṃ tvāṃ kathamantaḥ svānte cintayāmi na kathañcit | tasmānmayi praṇayini tvatprārthanāvahite svayameva prasīda praśamitadehādipramātṛtābhimānakāluṣyaḥ prasphura || 20 ||
yattadvedyaṃ kimapi paramaṃ śabdatattvaṃ tvamanta(-) statsadvyaktiṃ jigamiṣu śanairlāti mātrākalāḥ khe | avyaktena praṇavavapuṣā bindunādoditaṃ sa(-) cchabdabrahmoccaritakaraṇavyañjitaṃ vācakaṃ te || 21 ||
yatkimapyasāmānyaṃ tvaṃ tadantarityantarmukhānavacchinnaprakāśātmani pade | śabdatattvamiti śāstraṃ śabdātmakaṃ sarvaṃ śabdo haṃsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ iti śrīsvacchandādiṣṭānāhatabhaṭṭārakarūpam | paramamiti paramotkṛṣṭam | yaduktaṃ śrīkālottare (-) nādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ iti | vedyamiti suprakaṭasusphurattātmakatvādanapahnavanīyam | na tu vidikriyākarmātmakam | yaduktaṃ śrīsvacchande (-)
yasya rūpaṃ śarīraṃ vā nāsti varṇaḥ kriyā tathā | sa kathaṃ gṛhyate sūkṣmo hyagrāhyo nityamavyayaḥ || iti |
śrībhargaśikhāyāmapi (-)

agnīṣomau prakṛtipuruṣau bindunādau ca nityau prāṇāpānāvapi dinaniśe ye ca satyānṛte dve | dharmādharmau sadasadubhayaṃ yo'ntarāveśya yogī vartetātmanyuparatamatirnirguṇaṃ tvāṃ viśet saḥ || 25 ||
yo yogī nityau satatavāhinau prāṇāpānāveva kavalanāpyāyanahetutvādagnīṣomau jñānakriyāśaktiprādhānyāt prakṛtipuruṣau vedanavimarśatvād bindunādau prasaraviśrāntipadatvād dinaniśe vikāsasaṃkocanimittatvāt satyānṛte ūrdhvādhogatikāraṇatvād dharmādharmau bāhyānāṃ sattāsattayorjñāpakatvāt sadasadubhayamantarudānadhāmni āveśya vilāpyātmani ciddhāmni vartetāvatiṣṭheta sa tvāṃ nirguṇaṃ sattvādiguṇātītaṃ paramādityaṃ viśatyeva || 25 ||
garbhādhānaprasavavidhaye suptayorindubhāsā sāpatnyenābhimukhamiva khe kāntayormadhyasaṃsthaḥ | dyāvāpṛthvyorvadanakamale gomukhairbodhayitvā paryāyeṇāpibasi bhagavan ṣaḍrasāsvādalolaḥ || 26 ||
he bhagavaṃścidbhāno (!) dyāvāpṛthvyoḥ sarvadvādaśāntātmāntarikṣadehabhūmyoḥ kāntayornijavijñānenaiva ramaṇīyatāṃ prāpitayorvadanakamale śaktinaline gomukhairanuttarairmarīcibhirbodhayitvā vikāsya asāmānyaśāktānandāsvādanalampaṭaḥ san paryāyeṇa vicitronmeṣanimeṣakramairāpibasi camatkuruṣe | kīdṛśaḥ (?) madhyasaṃstho'gnīṣomādhirūḍhaḥ | kimartham (?) garbhe svāntaryadādhānaṃ prakṣepo'rthādviśvasya prasavastadaucityena bhāsanaṃ tadvidhānārtham | kīdṛśyordyāvāpṛthivyoḥ (?) khe śūnyapramātari suptayoḥ kalodvalitametacca cittattvaṃ kartṛtāmayam | acidrūpasya śūnyādermitaṃ guṇatayā sthitam || iti nītyā śūnyapradhānatāśrayeṇa nimajjitapāramārthikasvarūpayorabhimukhāvasthitayoḥ | kathaṃ suptayoḥ (?) sāpatnyena parasparapratiyogitayaivābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā | ubhayānukūlatvādābhimukhyamāśrityetyarthaḥ | bāhyo'pyarko dyāvāpṛthivyo rātrābindubhāsā suptayormīlitasvarūpayorabhimukhāvasthitayormadhya gobhirvadananaline vikāsya tadīyavicitrarasāsvādalola āpibati bhaumāntarikṣān rasān | garbhādhānāya grīṣmādau karṣaṇyādinijaraśmyantarniveśanāya | prāvṛḍādau ca prasavāya varṣaṇyādimarīcivisargato nānauṣadhyuptaye | atha ca sāpatnyenābhimukhayoḥ suptayorindubhāsopalakṣitayoḥ karpūrāchhuritayoḥ kāntayormadhyasaṃstho nāyako vaidagdhyād gomukhairvaktrapadme paryāyeṇa yugapad bodhayitvā locanaparicumbanapuraḥsaramunnidre vidhāya vaktrāsavāmṛtalampaṭo garbhasyādhānaprasavanimittamāpibati rataye'tyarthaṃ paricumbatīti śleṣāṅkāraḥ śleṣadhvanisaṃsṛṣṭaśca || 26 ||
somaṃ pūrṇāmṛtamiva caruṃ tejasā sādhayitvā kṛtvā tenānalamukhajagattarpaṇaṃ vaiśvadevam | āmāvasyaṃ vighasamiva khe tatkalāśeṣamaśnan brahmāṇḍāntargṛhapatiriva svātmayāgaṃ karoṣi || 27 ||

he dinakara viśvodayakāridivasasaṃpādaka cidbhāno(,) jagataḥ sadāśivāntasya viśvasya yad bījamārambhāvasānayorudayāpavargakāraṇaṃ śrīsvacchandādiṣṭavitataparārdhātmakālarūpamahorātraṃ tatkṛtvābhāsya tatraivāntarjagataḥ kalādikṣityantasyāśuddhādhvarūpasya bījaṃ māyeyamahorātraṃ tadantarapyāvyaktikaṃ prākṛtaṃ tadantarapi brāhmaṃ tatrāpi daivaṃ tatrāpi pitryaṃ pitṛsambandhi tatrāpi mānuṣaṃ krameṇālpamalpaṃ kurvan kurvanniva vaicitryasahasrairābhāsayanniva jagadviśvaṃ pañcadhāvartanābhirvicitrajāgarādidaśāpañcakaparāvartanaiḥ kalayasi antaravasthitaṃ bahiḥ kṣipasi | nirmimīṣe nirmitaṃ ca kalayasi | idamitthamidamidamiti saṃkhyānena sthāpayasi | sthāpitamapi kalayasi antaḥsaṃharasi | saṃhṛtamapi kalayasi saṃskāragālanena vimṛśasi | vimṛṣṭamapi kalayasi svātmābhedena jānīṣe svaprakāśaikātmyamāpādayasi | tathā punarapi svarūpāt kalayasi navaṃ navamullāsayasi | ityevaṃ sargasthitisaṃhṛtivilāpanasvātmaikyābhāsanaparasparāndolanalīlākrāntaṃ karoṣi | atra jagadbījamāvartya dviryojyam | alpamalpamiti vīpsāyām | ayamāśayaḥ (-) yadyasya yāvadahorātraṃ tattadīye prāṇacāre tadaṃśāṃśakāsvapi vā śrīsvacchandādiṣṭamāsodayādiṣaṣṭyabdodayāntaprakriyayā yogijñānāpekṣayātiparimitamābhāsayati bhagavān(,) tatrāpyantarviśvaikātmyaprathanāt sādāśivāntakālakalanāmaśeṣāmābhāsayatītyābhāsamāno'yaṃ kālo na tvasya vāstavaṃ kiñcittattvamasti | ata eva kurvannivetīvaśabdenāyamevārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | vastuto hyetāvadviśvodayāvasthānavilāpanādyātmā parameśvara eveti sphurati | na tu cidekavapuṣastato'tiriktaṃ kimapyasti | atra ca mānuṣādyahorātrapramāṇaṃ śrīsvacchande coktam | tadyathā (-)

ābrahmaṇaḥ śāktādrūpādābrahma nijaṃ paraṃ śāktaṃ rūpaṃ varjayitvā idaṃ sarvaṃ sādāśivādikṣityantaṃ jaṅgamasthāvare antau bhāgau yasya tādṛg jagatsarge sarge prathamecchonmeṣātmanyādisarge bhūyo bhūya udriktasomaiḥ sphītaśāktāmṛtairgobhirmarīcibhirvisṛjasi āśyānībhūtaṃ nijaraśmirūpaṃ prakaṭayasi | bhūyo dīptairagnipradhānirgobhistajjagadyathāyoni pratyāharasi svasvātantryāvabhāsitatattatkāraṇaniveśapuraḥsaraṃ laye svacidaikyābhāsanātmani saṃhāre pratīpamāharasi cidekamayameva karoṣi | kiṃ kurvan (?) sargasya sṛṣṭerādau ante prakaṭavibhavāṃ sphuṭamāhātmyāṃ raśmilīlāṃ prakaṭayannijamarīcivilāsamābhāsayan || 30 ||
śritvā nityopacitamucitaṃ brahmatejaḥprakāśaṃ rūpaṃ sargasthitilayamucā sarvabhūteṣu madhye | antevāsiṣviva suguruṇā yaḥ parokṣaḥ prakṛtyā pratyakṣo'sau jagati bhavatā darśitaḥ svātmanātmā || 31 ||
he bhagavan(,) yaḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvena parokṣo'kṣāgocara ātmā asau jagati sarvabhūteṣu madhye bhavatā'ntevāsiṣu anugrāhyeṣu ātmanaiva pratyakṣo darśitaḥ svaprakāśatayā prakaṭīkṛtaḥ | kiṃ kṛtvā (?) nityopacitaṃ sadā paripūrṇamucitaṃ cidānandaghanaṃ rūpaṃ śritvā dehādinimajjanenonmagnaṃ vidhāya | kīdṛg rūpam (?) brahmatejaḥprakāśaṃ bṛhattvād bṛṃhakatvācca brahma dvaitadāhitvāttejo yasya tādṛśaḥ prakāśaḥ prathā yasya | kīdṛśena bhavatā (?) sargasthitilayamucā jananādiśūnyena yathāntevāsiṣu śiṣyeṣu śobhanena dṛṣṭatattvena guruṇā ātmā darśyate cinmayī sattā prakaṭīkriyate(,) tathā tvayāntaḥ paramātmatayā bahiśca tejo viśvarūpatayā svayamātmā prakaṭīkriyate || 31 ||
lokāḥ sarve vapuṣi niyataṃ te sthitāstvaṃ ca teṣā(-) mekaikasmin yugapadaguṇo viśvahetorguṇīva | itthaṃbhūte bhavati bhagavanna tvadanyo'smi satyaṃ kintu jñastvaṃ paramapuruṣo'haṃ prakṛtyaiva cājñaḥ || 32 ||
he bhagavan parānandātmaka svātantryaśaktisvarūpaparāvāgāliṅgitamūrte(,) te tava viśvahetoraśeṣakāraṇasya vapuṣi prakāśānandaghane svarūpe sarve lokā lokyamānāḥ padārthāḥ(,) lokayitāraśca rudrakṣetrajñarūpāḥ pramātāraḥ sthitāḥ | tvaccidātmikāṃ sattāṃ vinā hi kathamete tvatto viśvahetorudiyuḥ | teṣāṃ ca lokānāṃ saṃbandhinyekaikasmin vapuṣi tvaṃ yugapadakrameṇaiva sthitaḥ | anyathā te tvatprakāśatāṃ vinā hi kathaṃ prakāśeran | ataśca tvaṃ sattvādiguṇahīno'pi viśvātmatābhāsaguṇād guṇīvābhāsi | itthamupavarṇite viśvātmani bhavati sati satyamasmi nānyaḥ | kintu tvamevaṃbhūtaḥ paramaḥ puruṣo jñaḥ paripūrṇaḥ sārvajñyādidharmaḥ | ahamiti tvayaiva dehādiṣu grāhitapramātṛbhāvaḥ prakṛtyā tvanmāyāmāhātmyādajñaḥ | ataśca dehādipramātṛtānimajjanenājñatāṃ praśamayya nityaṃ svātmasamāveśena jñatāṃ mamonmajjayetyarthāduktaṃ bhavati || 32 ||
saṃkalpecchādyakhilakaraṇaprāṇavāṇyo vareṇyāḥ saṃpannā me tvadabhinavanājjanma cedaṃ śaraṇyam | manye cāstaṃ jigamiṣu śanaiḥ puṇyapāpadvayaṃ tad bhaktiśraddhe tava caraṇayoranyathā no bhavetām || 33 ||
itthamajñasyāpi me tvadabhinavanāccidātmatvadābhimukhyapravṛttatvatparāmarśātmastutivaśāt | saṃkalpaḥ sthūlecchā | icchā saṅkalpakāraṇabhūtā sūkṣmavikalpaparāmarśātmā | ādiśabdāt prayatnastadanantaramālocanādānādipravṛttāni vāgvarjānyakhilāni karaṇāni satsahavṛttiḥ prāṇaḥ(,) sarvatrātra sūkṣmaparāmarśarūpatayā vyāpakatvena sthitā vāṇī cetyete mama varaṇe parānugrahe sādhavo vareṇyā jātāḥ(,) tathedamiti paścimajanma śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇe sādhu anugrāhyānugrahaikaparaṃ sampannam | ahaṃ hi sarvadaśāsu cidarkaparāmarśaparaḥ parānapyanugṛhṇan sthitaḥ | kiñca(,) manye svānubhavenaivaitaccetaye yatpuṇyapāpadvayaṃ sukṛtāsukṛtajātaṃ sarvaṃ tadityanantajanmārjitaṃ śanairastaṃ jigamiṣu himavilāyaṃ vilīyamānaṃ sthitam | prāksaṃcitasarvakarmaṇāṃ hi dhvaṃse'pi dehārambhakakarmaṇāṃ dhvaṃsonmukhatvājjigamiṣvityuktam | anyatheti | yadi naivaṃ syāttatkathaṃ bhavaccaraṇayorbhaktiśraddhe bhavetām | naiva syātām | yaduktaṃ nandiśikhāyām (-)
yadā śive'bhilāṣo vai jāyate ca nṛṇāṃ sadā | tadā śivābhimānāste jāyante paramāṇavaḥ || muktāstadaiva te dīkṣāṃ prāpnuvanti gurostataḥ || iti || 33 ||
satyaṃ bhūyo jananamaraṇe tvatprapanneṣu na sta(-) statrāpyekaṃ tava nutiphalaṃ janma yāce tadittham | trailokyeśaḥ śama iva paraḥ puṇyakāyo'pyayoniḥ saṃsārābdhau plava iva jagattāraṇāya sthiraḥ syām || 34 ||
he deva(,) yadyapi tvatprapanneṣu tvatsamāviṣṭeṣu saṃsārahetusarvavāsanādāhād bhūyo jananamaraṇe na staḥ(,) tathāpi tvannutistvatstutireva phalaṃ yasya tādṛgidamekaṃ paścimajanma yāce | yathā bhavadavamarśātmacamatkārādhāyi etanmāgāt | taditthamanenaiva tvannutirasāviṣṭena prakāreṇāsminneva dehe paraḥ śama iva śāmyatyasmin viśvamiti vyutpattyā paraḥ śaṅkarātmasvabhāva iva jāgratsvapnasuṣuptātmani trailokye īśaḥ prabhuḥ | na tu paratantraḥ | ata eva puṇyo darśanasparśanādinā parānugrāhī kāyo yasya tādṛk | ayoniriti nityoditacidānandaikaghanaḥ san jagato viśvasya tāraṇāya saṃsārābdhimadhye plava iva pota iva sthiraḥ syāṃ cirakālaṃ bhūyāsam || 34 ||
sauṣumṇena tvamamṛtapathenaitya śītāṃśubhāvaṃ puṣṇāsyagre suranarapitṝn śāntabhābhiḥ kalābhiḥ | paścādambho viśasi vividhāścauṣadhīstadgato'pi prīṇāsyevaṃ tribhuvanamataste jaganmitratārka || 35 ||
he arka (!) ato hetoste jagato mitratā yaugikamitraśabdābhidheyatvam(,) yatastvaṃ sauṣumṇena madhyamenāmṛtapathenāpyāyinā mārgeṇa śītāṃśubhāvamapānacandratvametyāgatyāgre prathamaṃ surādīn sarvān pramātṝn puṣṇāsi labdhāvasthitīn karoṣi | kena śāntamābhirantarmukhībhāvenopasaṃhṛtabāhyaprathābhiḥ kalābhirādivisargāntasvābhāvimarśaśaktibhiḥ | paścādanantaramambha iti bahiḥ prasarapravṛttān sarvavāhān viśasi svāmṛtācchuritān karoṣi | vividhāścauṣadhīrviśasi sthāvarādisarvabāhyābhāsān svaprakāśāpūritān vidhatse | tadgato meyaprapañcātmatayā sphurito'pi tribhuvanaṃ viśvamevamiti tadābhāsanavimarśanayuktyaiva candratvametya pūrvoktanītyā surādīn prīṇāsi tarpayasi | bāhyo'pyarkaḥ suṣumṇāmārgeṇāmṛtasaṃkramaṇayuktyā candratvametya pūrvoktanītyā surādīn puṣṇāti | śāntabhābhirnivṛttadīptibhiḥ kalābhiḥ śaktibhirambho viśati dakṣiṇāyane āsārarūpatāṃ svīkaroti | oṣadhīśca viśati sarasāḥ karoti | tadgataśca vaiśvadevayāgānuyāgakrameṇa tribhuvanaṃ puṣṇan jaganmitratvameva darśayati || 35 ||
mandākrānte tamasi bhavatā nātha doṣāvasāne nāntarlīnā mama matiriyaṃ gāḍhanidrāṃ jahāti | tasmādastaṃgamitatamasā padminīvātmabhāsā saurītyeṣā dinakara paraṃ nīyatāmāśu bodham || 36 ||
he nātha dinakara svāmin cidarka(,) tvayā tamasyajñāne mandākrānte nirmūlanāyāghrāte sati iyaṃ madīyā matirdhī rāgadveṣāṇāmavasāne jāte'pi antarlīnāntarmukhībhūtāpi gāḍhanidrāṃ tvadabhedākhyātiṃ na jahāti | tasmādeṣā tvayā astaṃgamitaṃ tamo yayā tādṛśyātmabhāsā svadīptyā kāraṇabhūtayā āśvavilambitameva paraṃ bodhaṃ praśāntākhyātinijajyotirātmatāṃ nīyatāṃ prāpyatām | sūryo devatā yasyāḥ sā saurīti kṛtvā padminīva nalinīva | sāpi tvayā doṣāvasāne prabhāte tamasi mandākrānte'ntarlīnā karṇikāsaṃśliṣṭadalā gāḍhanidrāṃ na jahātītyastaṃgamitatamasā svātmabhāsā gāḍhībhūtajyotiṣā prabodhyate tvayā || 36 ||
yena grāsīkṛtamiva jagatsarvamāsīttadastaṃ dhvāntaṃ nītvā punarapi vibho taddayāghrātacittaḥ | dhatse naktaṃdinamapi gatī śuklakṛṣṇe vibhajya trātā tasmādbhavaparibhave duṣkṛte me'pi bhāno || 37 ||
he vibho bhāno cinmarīcimālin(,) yena tamasā'jñānena jagadidaṃ grāsīkṛtamāsīt(,) tadanugṛhītān pratyastaṃ nītvā vināśya taddayāghrātacitta iva tadanukampayaiva śuklakṛṣṇagatī vibhajya vyutthānāvasare prāṇāpānabhūmikāmavaruhya tad dhvāntaṃ punarapi dhatse puṣṇāsi | nirvyutthanaṃ samādhiṃ jhagiti na vitarasītyarthaḥ | yathā bāhyo bhānurgrāsīkṛtajagattimiraṃ vināśya punardayayeva naktaṃdinaṃ niśādine vibhajya dhatte puṣṇātīti śleṣopamā | yata evaṃ durātmani tamasyapi tvamanukampāvāniva tato me mama paribhave vyutthānātmani kleśe'pi trātā rakṣitā bhava | kīdṛśe paribhave (?) duṣkṛte duṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ karaṇaṃ viṣayahānādānādiparibhavo yatra | nirvyutthānasamāveśarasāsvādinaṃ māṃ kurvityarthaḥ || 37 ||
vyutthitaḥ samāveśamaprāpnuvan vyutthānadaśānirbhartsanaparaḥ samāveśaparaṃ bhagavantaṃ prārthayitumāha (-)
āsaṃsāropacitasadasatkarmabandhāśritānā(-) mādhivyādhiprajanamaraṇakṣutpipāsārditānām | mithyājñānaprabalatamasā nātha cāndhīkṛtānāṃ tvaṃ nastrātā bhava karuṇayā yatratatrasthitānām || 38 ||
satpuṇyam | asatpāpam | yatratatrasthitānāmiti deśe kāle'vasthāvaicitrye ca trātā samāveśaprathanena rakṣakaḥ | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam || 38 ||
satyāsatyaskhalitavacasāṃ śaucalajjojjhitānā(-) majñānānāmaphalasaphalaprārthanākātarāṇām | sarvāvasthāsvakhilaviṣayābhyastakautūhalānāṃ tvaṃ nastrātā bhava pitṛtayā bhogalolārbhakāṇām || 39 ||
bhogeṣu viṣayasukheṣu lampaṭānāmasmākamarbhakāṇāṃ bālānāmiva tvaṃ pitṛtayā janakatvena trātā bhaveti prāgvat | tvaṃ hyasmākaṃ tattvadṛṣṭyā janakaḥ | satyāsatyetyubhayatra samam | skhalitaṃ pramādi ekatra(,) anyatrā'spaṣṭavarṇatvam | evaṃ śaucaṃ caittaṃ śārīraṃ ca | aphalā saphalā ca yā prārthanā tayā kātarāṇāmadhīrāṇām | yattatprārthayamānānāmiti | subodhamanyat || 39 ||
yāvaddehaṃ jarayati jarā nāntakādetya dūtī no vā bhīmastriphaṇabhujagākāradurvārapāśaḥ | gāḍhaṃ kaṇṭhe lagati sahasā jīvitaṃ lelihāna(-) stāvadbhaktābhayada sadayaṃ śreyase naḥ prasīda || 40 ||
he bhaktābhayada(,) yāvadvyutthitāmaraṇāvasānāṃ durdaśāṃ nāpnumastāvanno'smākaṃ prasīda dehādisaṃskārakāluṣyapraśamanena nirmalībhava | nirvyutthānaprakāśānandaghanaparamasamāveśā(-) mṛtarasāsvādasukhitānasmān saṃpādayetyarthaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 40 ||
viśvaprāṇagrasanarasanāṭopakopapragalbhaṃ mṛtyorvaktraṃ dahananayanoddāmadaṃṣṭrākarālam | yāvad dṛṣṭvā vrajati na bhiyā pañcatāmeṣa kāya(-) stāvannityāmṛtamaya rave pāhi naḥ kāṃdiśīkān || 41 ||
mṛtyorantakasya vaktraṃ dṛṣṭvā yāvadeṣa kāya iti sapuryaṣṭako deho bhiyā bhītyā pañcatāṃ mṛtyuṃ na vrajati tāvadeva rave cidarka nityāmṛtamaya anastamitaparamānandaikaghanasvabhāva no'smān kāṃdiśīkān vyutthāne tvatsamāveśaprāptiṃ vinā kāṃ diśaṃ kāyataḥ kā dikkā digasmākamiti krandataḥ pāhi nirvyutthanasamāveśān saṃpādaya | kīdṛṅ mṛtyorvaktram (?) viśveṣāṃ prāṇagrasano jīvitabhakṣako rasanāṭopo lolarasanāvyāpāro yasya tādṛśi kope pragalbhaṃ prauḍham | tathā dahanāni ploṣakāṇi nayanāni yasya tādṛk | tathā uddāmābhirūrjitābhirdaṃṣṭrābhiḥ karālam || 41 ||
śabdākāraṃ viyadiva vapuste yajuḥsāmadhāmnaḥ saptacchandāṃsyapi ca turagā ṛṅmayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca | evaṃ sarvaśrutimayatayā maddayānugrahādvā kṣipraṃ mattaḥ kṛpaṇakaruṇākrandamākarṇayemam || 42 ||
he bhagavan(,) te tava nirṇītadṛśā sāmavedātmakaṃ dhāma tejo yasya tādṛśaḥ | yajurvedātmakaṃ śabdākāraṃ vapuḥ śarīraṃ viyadiva vyāpakam | tadapi śabdākāramiti śabdānākaroti samastaśabdāśrayaḥ | api ca gāyatryādi saptacchandāṃsi te turagāḥ | maṇḍalaṃ prabhā pariveṣo'pi ṛgvedamaya ityevaṃ sarvaśrutimayatvāt | yadvā anukampāpradhānādanugrahānmatto matsakāśāduktavakṣyamāṇaprārthanāparatvāt kṛpaṇaṃ virasaṃ saṃsāravibhāvakatvācca karuṇaṃ karuṇarasapradhānamimamākrandaṃ tvatprasādaprārthanāparaṃ pralapitaṃ kṣipramudīraṇānantaramevākarṇaya karuṇayā'smadanujighṛkṣayā'vadhāraya || 42 ||
nāśaṃ nāsmaccaraṇaśaraṇā yāntyapi grasyamānā devairitthaṃ sitamiva yaśo darśayan svaṃ trilokyām | manye somaṃ kṣatatanumamāgarbhavṛddhyā vivasvan śuklacchāyāṃ nayasi śanakaiḥ svāṃ suṣumṇāṃśubhāsā || 43 ||
he bhagavan vivasvan cidbhāno asmaccaraṇaśaraṇā devairapi grasyamānā nāśaṃ na yānti ityevaṃ sitaṃ śubhraṃ yaśastrilokyāṃ darśayanniva somaṃ kṣatatanuṃ devairapi grastasamastakalaṃ suṣumṇākhyamadhyanāḍyā aṃśavo marīcayastadbhāsā dīptyā hetubhūtayā amākhyakalayā garbhe'ntaryā vṛddhistayā svāṃ śuklāṃ chāyāṃ saṃpūrṇasitāṃ kāntiṃ nayasi prāpayasīti manye jānāmi | atra rahasyadṛśā devā indriyāṇi somo'pānayuktyāntaḥpraviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśakalārūpātmā meyavargaḥ sarvavāhollāsayuktyā kalāgrāsena kṣīṇakalaḥ san suṣumṇāṃśubhāsā madhyadhāmasphāreṇonmiṣacchubhākhyaturyaprakāśadīptyā amāyā antatuṭyardhasphuracchaktergarbhe'ntaryā vṛddhiḥ prāṇādiprādhānyanimeṣonmiṣacchāktavīryabhābhiḥ sphuritā(,) tayā śuklāṃ cidekaghanāṃ nayasi prāpayasītyarthaḥ | bāhyastu spaṣṭaḥ || 43 ||
āstāṃ janmaprabhṛti bhavataḥ sevanaṃ taddhi loke vācyaṃ kenāparimitaphalaṃ bhuktimuktiprakāram | jyotirmātraṃ smṛtipathamito jīvitānte'pi bhāsvan nirvāṇāya prabhavasi satāṃ tena te kaḥ samo'nyaḥ || 44 ||
he bhāsvan(,) janmaprabhṛti yattvatsevanaṃ tadaparimitaphalaṃ kena vācyaṃ kena vaktuṃ śakyam(,) iyattayā paricchedyatvābhāvāt | tadyasmād bhuktimuktiprakāraṃ bhuktirviṣayabhoga eva svātmānandaviśrāntidatvena jīvacchivatvābhivyaktātmā muktireva ca ciccamatkārāveśarūpā bhuktiḥ(,) na tu viṣayāsaktirūpā | tāṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prakāśayati sevakāṃstanmayān saṃpādayati jīvitānte nirvāṇāvasare'pi jyotirmātrātmā tvaṃ satāṃ smṛtipathaṃ prāpto nirvāṇāya muktaye prabhavasi | ataste samaḥ ko'nyaḥ | asāmānyamahimā'sītyarthaḥ || 44 ||
apratyakṣatridaśabhajanādyatparokṣaṃ phalaṃ tat puṃsāṃ yuktaṃ bhavati hi samaṃ kāraṇenaiva kāryam | pratyakṣastvaṃ sakalajagatāṃ yatsamakṣaṃ phalaṃ me yuṣmadbhakteḥ samucitamatastattu yāce yathā tvām || 45 ||
apratyakṣendra candrādidevatārādhanādārādhakānāṃ yatsvargaprāptyādi parokṣaṃ kālāntare bhāvi phalaṃ tadyuktam | yato mṛda iva mṛṇmayo ghaṭaḥ kāraṇocitameva sarvatra kāryaṃ bhavati | tvaṃ tu cidarkaḥ sarveṣāṃ pratyakṣaḥ svaprakāśaḥ(,) cidarkasvaprakāśātmatāṃ vinā kasyāpyaprakāśāditi | tvadbhakterhetormama nityoditatvatsamāveśātmaphalaṃ samucitam | ato hetostatphalaṃ yāce prārthaye | yathā kṛtimatīṣu devatāsu satīṣu tvāmeva yāce tathā nirvyutthānasamāveśātmaiva phalaṃ yāce | na tu mitaṃ kiñcit || 45 ||
ye cārogyaṃ diśati bhagavān sevito'pyevamāhu(-) ste tattvajñā jagati subhagā bhogayogapradhānāḥ | bhuktermukterapi ca jagatāṃ yacca pūrṇaṃ sukhānāṃ tasyānyorkādamṛtavapuṣaḥ ko hi nāmāstu dātā || 46 ||
ye'pi ca kecidavimṛṣṭasamāveśātmamukhyaphalā bhagavānsevita ārogyaṃ diśatītyāhuste'pi jagati tattvajñāśca subhagāśca | yato bhogayogapradhānā bhogāya yogāya cārogyaṃ vāñcanti | yuktaṃ caitat | yato'mṛtavapuṣaḥ parānandaprakāśaghanāccidarkādanyaḥ ko nāma bhogamoṣayostadāśrayasya pūrṇasukhātmana ārogyasya ca dātā | na kaścit | pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha iti tṛptyarthaiḥ saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhājjñāpakāt sukhānāṃ pūrṇamityatra ṣaṣṭhī || 46 ||
hitvā hitvā gurucapalatāmapyanekānnijārthā(-) nyairekārthīkṛtamiva bhavatsevanaṃ matpriyārtham | teṣāmicchāmyupakṛtimahaṃ svendriyāṇāṃ priyāṇā(-) mādau tasmānmama dinapate dehi tebhyaḥ prasādam || 47 ||
he dinapate cidbhāno(,) yairindriyairantarbahiḥkaraṇairgurvīṃ capalatāṃ mahatīmanavasthitiṃ punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttāmapi tathā'nekānnijārthān viṣayaviśrāntyātmakāni nānāsvaprayojanāni hitvā tyaktvā bhavatsevanamantarmukhībhāvayuktyā tvatpariśīlanaṃ mama priyārthamevaikārthīkṛtamabhiniveśenāśritam | teṣāṃ priyāṇāṃ svendriyāṇāmahamupakāramicchāmi | tasmānmamādau tebhyaḥ prasādaṃ dehi māyīyadehaparihāreṇa nijamarīcicakrātmatāṃ prakaṭayetyarthaḥ || 47 ||
kiṃ tannāmoccarati vacanaṃ yasya noccārakastvaṃ kiṃ tadvācyaṃ sakalavacasāṃ viśvamūrte na yat tvam | tasmāduktaṃ yadapi tadapi tvannutau bhaktiyogā(-) dasmābhistadbhavatu bhagavaṃstvatprasādena dhanyam || 48 ||
he viśvamūrte anavacchinna(,) tvannutiviṣaye idantāvacchedapradhānatayā asamañjasaprāyaṃ kimapyasmābhistvadbhaktita uktaṃ tadviśvasya vācyavācakātmanastava prasādādantarnairmalyaprāpterdhanyamastu tvadrūpatayaiva sphuratu || 48 ||
yā panthānaṃ diśati śiśirādyuttaraṃ devayānaṃ yā vā kṛṣṇaṃ pitṛpathamatho dakṣiṇaṃ prāvṛḍādyam | tābhyāmanyā viṣuvadabhijinmadhyamā kṛtyaśūnyā dhanyā kācitprakṛtipuruṣāvantarā me'stu vṛttiḥ || 49 ||
prakṛtipuruṣau vāmadakṣiṇabāhau antarā tanmadhye kācidasāmānyā dhanyā saṃpanmayī me vṛttiḥ sthitirastu | kīdṛśī (?) viṣuṃ vyāptimarhatīti viṣuvat | abhijayati dvaitapraśamanāt sarvotkarṣeṇa vartata ityabhijit | sarvamadhyavartitvānmadhyamā | svānandaviśrāntisāratvāt kṛtyaiḥ saumyakrūrādibhiḥ kāryaiḥ śūnyā | tathā devaprītikāritvāddevayānaṃ hṛdo dvādaśāntaṃ yāvat prasaraṇarūpaṃ śiśiravasantagrīṣmasvabhāvamuttarapanthānamuttarāyaṇaṃ yā prāṇākhyā vṛttirdiśati prathayati(,) yā vā apānākhyā vṛttirdvādaśāntāddhṛtpraveśarūpā prāvṛṭśaraddhemantarūpaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ panthānaṃ dakṣiṇāyanaṃ bhogapradatvāt kṛṣṇaṃ pitṛprītihetutvātpitṛpathaṃ diśati tābhyāmanyā vyatiriktā jīvanmuktipradā | unmanākhyetyarthaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgule'ṅgulaṣaṭke hṛdaḥprabhṛti makarādirāśyudaya ityarthaḥ śrīsvacchandādi śāstreṣvasti || 49 ||
sthitvā kiñcinmana iva piban setubandhasya madhye prāpyopeyaṃ dhruvapadamatho vyaktamuddālya tālu | satyādūrdhvaṃ kimapi paramaṃ vyoma somāgniśūnyaṃ gaccheyaṃ tvāṃ surapitṛgatī cāntarā brahmabhūtaḥ || 50 ||
surapitṛgatī antarā ūrdhvādhaḥpraveśātmanirṇītadevapitṛmārgayormadhye cakārāt sarvavāhānāmapyantarbrahmabhūto'navacchinnatāṃ prāptastvāṃ gaccheyaṃ paratattvātmacidarkarūpaḥ syām | kīdṛśaṃ tvām (?) satyādviśvasattāpradāt sāmarasyāddhāmna ūrdhvamutkṛṣṭaṃ prakāśānandaikaghanaṃ kimapi paramaṃ vyometyanuttaracidākāśarūpaṃ somāgniśūnyaṃ praśāntaprāṇāpānasaṃskāram | kiṃ kṛtvā (?) tālulambikākhyaraudragranthidhāmavyaktiṃ kṛtvā | divyakaraṇabandhāśrayata uddālya nirbhidya | atho anantaraṃ dhruvapadaṃ prāpya samastavedyāvibhāgaprakāśātmabindusthānamāsādya | setubandhasya madhya iti nirodhakordhvaśaktyā taṭadvayāntarvāhiprāṇāpānādyuttaraṇopāyanādanādātmasṛṣṭiniruddha(-) samastakarandhramārge sthitvā'dhiruhya kiñcinmanaḥ pibanniva samanāntasavikalpakamanaḥsaṃskāraṃ praśamayan || 50 ||
sarvātmatvaṃ savituriti yo vāṅmanaḥkāyabuddhyā rāgadveṣopaśamasamatāyogamevārurukṣuḥ | dharmādharmagrasanaraśanāmuktaye yuktiyuktāṃ sa śrīsāmbaḥ stutimiti raveḥ svapraśāntāṃ cakāra || 51 ||
śrayantyetāṃ yogina iti śrīstayā mokṣalakṣmyā sahitaḥ sāmbo bhagavadvāsudevasuta ityevaṃrūpāṃ raveścidarkasya stutiṃ svapraśāntāmātmaviśrāntiparāmakarot | supratiṣṭhām iti vā pāṭhaḥ | kīdṛśīṃ stutim (?) yuktyā parasvarūpaviśrāntyātmanā yogena yuktām | tatkhyāpayitrīmityarthaḥ | sa ityasya viṣayaṃ darśayati (-) yāḥ saviturviśvakāraṇasya cidbhānoḥ sarvātmatvaṃ vaiśvarūpyameva yogamekatvamicchati | vastuno'nyena vastunā ityāmnāyadṛśā yogaṃ paraikyamityuktadṛśāroḍhumicchuḥ svīcikīrṣuḥ | na tvanyatkiñcit | kīdṛśaṃ yogam (?) sarvadoṣamūrdhanyayo rāgadveṣayorupaśame sati yā samatā sāmyaṃ tadrūpam | kena (?) vāṅmanaḥ (-) kāyasahitayā buddhyā | vācā stutibhiḥ(,) manasā'nusaṃdhānataḥ(,) kāyena kāyaprādhyānyena nimajjanātmakapraṇāmena(,) buddhyā'dhyavasāyena | kimarthamimāṃ stutimakarodityāha (-) dharmādharmābhyāṃ yadgrasanamarthādabuddhasya jagatastadeva raśanā bandhanarajjustasyā muktaye | etatstotrapāṭhāvamarśābhyāṃ janā jīvanmuktimāyāntvityāśayādityarthaḥ || 51 ||
bhaktiśraddhādyakhilataruṇīvallabhenedamuktaṃ śrīsāmbena prakaṭagahanaṃ stotramadhyātmagarbham | yaḥ sāvitraṃ paṭhati niyataṃ svātmavat sarvalokān paśyan so'nte vrajati śukavanmaṇḍalaṃ caṇḍaraśmeḥ || 52 ||
idamadhyātmagarbhaṃ kroḍīkṛtarahasyam(,) prakaṭaṃ bāhyārthadṛśā(,) gahanaṃ cādhyātmakārthayogāt(,) sāvitraṃ cidbhānusambandhi stotraṃ śrīsāmbenoktaṃ yaḥ kaścit svātmānamiva sarvalokān paśyaṃścidabhedātmaviśvaṃ stotrārthaṃ bhāvayanniyataṃ niścayena paṭhati anavarataṃ vimṛśati(,) so'nte caṇḍaraśmerdvaitagrāsinaścidarkasya maṇḍalaṃ līḍhaviśvasamarasībhūtamarīcicakrameti | tanmayo jāyate | śukavad bhagavadvyāsasutavat | kīdṛśena sāmbena (?) bhaktiśraddhe ādī yāsāṃ tattvārthacintādīnāṃ tā evākhilāstaruṇyo navanavāḥ sundaryastāsāṃ vallabhena kṣaṇamapi parihartumaśakyena preyasā | na tu rūpalāvaṇyātiśayamātrāt samastabāhyaramaṇīspṛhaṇīyena | ityanena vyatirekalabhyenārthena bhagavadvāsudevasutatvamātmanaḥ prakaṭayati || 52 ||
upasaṃhārabhaṅgyā janānanujighṛkṣurāśāste (-)
iti paramarahasyaślokapañcāśadeṣā tapananavanapuṇyā sāgamabrahmacarcā | haratu duritamasmadvarṇitākarṇitā vo diśatu ca śubhasiddhiṃ mātṛvadbhaktibhājām || 53 ||
ityuktakramānmahārahasyārthayuktā sthitvā kiñcinmana iva piban ityantaślokānāṃ pañcāśadeṣā tapanasya viśvavicitrākhaṇḍitapratāpasya bhagavataścidarkasya navanena stutyā puṇyā pavitrā | tathā sāgamā viśvopaniṣadrūpamāheśvaraśāstrārthasatattvagarbhā brahmacarcā parādvayavimarśo yasyāṃ tādṛśī asmadvarṇitā satī ākarṇitā vo yuṣmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ duritaṃ haratu kilviṣaṃ duradhyavasāyaṃ ca nāśayatu | bhaktibhājāṃ ca śubhasiddhiṃ diśatu abhīṣṭāṃ bhogamokṣalakṣmīṃ ghaṭayatāmiti śivam || 53 ||
kaścicchaivaḥ paraśivasamāveśagāḍhānurāgo(-) drekasphūrjannabhinavadaśāveśavaivaśyaśālī | satstotre'smin vivṛtiracanāṃ kṣemarājo nyayuṅkte(-) tyetannaivaṃ jhaṭiti ghaṭitaṃ darśanīyaṃ hi sadbhiḥ ||
